# AVNISH AI

> Free online calculators for everyday personal and small-business calculations in India.

## Main tool
- https://avnishahirwar.github.io/calculator/ — GST, loan EMI, fixed deposit, discount, EPF/PF, savings interest, salary, SIP, inflation, BMI, fuel cost, income-tax estimate, age, electricity bill, salary TDS estimate, and profit/loss calculators.

## Information
- https://avnishahirwar.github.io/calculator/about.html — About AVNISH AI
- https://avnishahirwar.github.io/calculator/business.html — advertising, affiliate partnerships, subscriptions, API, white-label, widgets and business services
- https://avnishahirwar.github.io/calculator/api.html — Limited calculator API documentation and access request
- https://avnishahirwar.github.io/calculator/privacy.html — Privacy policy
- https://avnishahirwar.github.io/calculator/terms.html — Terms of use

## Important
- Browser calculators process entered values locally unless a visitor submits an enquiry form.
- Calculator outputs are estimates, not professional tax, legal, accounting, lending, or investment advice.
- API access is limited and requires approval.

## Commercial services
- Proposed revenue streams include display/direct advertising, sponsorships, affiliate partnerships, premium subscriptions, calculator API, white-label licensing, embeddable widgets, custom development, consent-based referrals, paid listings, downloadable reports and templates, implementation services, mobile apps and learning content.
- Professional (₹199/month) and Business (₹999/month) are indicative proposed prices only; subscriptions and payment checkout are not active.
- API access is subject to manual review. Advertising and affiliate programmes require approval. Personal data is not sold as a list.
